done_when: Every review prompt carries the standards page (src/forge/standards.md), the same text the worker brief carries, as rules the reviewer checks the change against, and the review reports a change that breaks one of its rules as a finding that names the rule. A test runs a review through Forge's command and shows the page's text reaches the reviewer.

findings.body: A reviewed branch can contain a tracked `forge-standards.md` symlink. Checkout recreates that link, and `write_text` follows it, so `forge close` can overwrite any file writable by Forge outside the temporary review tree before Autoreview starts. That breaks the rule that “no command changes a client repo outside a branch and PR.” Create the prompt file without following a branch-controlled path.
findings.title: Standard: Reversible by default

why: Workers build client apps with Forge's standards page in their brief, but the review never sees it, so a change that breaks one of its rules (API shapes, errors, data, frontend, tests, secrets, infrastructure) passes review
